about_the_game:
Dive into the mesmerizing soundscapes of "Bunny Space Odyssey: FlopHop Demo" with this demo soundtrack, offering a glimpse into the immersive audio journey that accompanies Ponchee's adventure. Composed by the game's creator and talented musician, Aink (Anna Glaid), these tracks are more than just background music—they're an integral part of the experience, intricately weaving the emotions and mysteries of FlopHop into every note.

Each piece in this collection reflects the essence of the strange, uninhabited planet, bringing to life its haunting beauty, the solitude of Ponchee’s journey, and the secrets waiting to be uncovered. Aink's deep passion for creating musical worlds shines through, making this demo soundtrack not just an accompaniment but a key to unlocking the heart of the game.

Step into the world of "Bunny Space Odyssey: FlopHop" and let the melodies of the demo soundtrack guide you through the first steps of Ponchee’s unforgettable odyssey. This is just the beginning—an invitation to a musical adventure that promises to resonate long after the final note fades.
